paras: Liolaemus duellmani, commonly known as Duellman's tree iguana, is a species of lizard in the family Liolaemidae. The species is endemic to Argentina.
The specific name, duellmani, is in honor of American herpetologist William Edward Duellman.
L. duellmani is found in Mendoza Province, Argentina.
The preferred natural habitat of L. duellmani is shrubland and grassland, at an altitude of 2,260 m (7,410 ft).
L. duellmani may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of about 8 cm (3.1 in).
